name: new-brain
description: One memory for all your work, shared by your AI tools. Set up New Brain, keep each project's memory current, and recall and save decisions, status and preferences as you work.

interface.longDescription: New Brain keeps what you decide, where each project stands, your preferences and the lessons you learn, with the sources they came from, and shares them with every AI tool you use. Set it up from what this app already knows, catch up on a project before you start, and save new decisions as you make them. Things the AI guesses wait in your To check list first.
defaultPrompt: Set up New Brain for me
Catch me up on my latest project
What did we decide last week?

positive.description: Recall a past decision with its source
positive.prompt: What did we decide about the database for Ledger API?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls recall with the question, project "Ledger API" and kinds ["decision"]. Answers that the team chose Postgres over SQLite because of row-level security, and names the source and date New Brain returned.

positive.prompt: Catch me up on Ledger API.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls catch_up with project "Ledger API". Summarises where the project stands from what came back, including the beta for 10 freelance bookkeepers due by 15 November 2026, with sources, and adds nothing New Brain did not return.

positive.description: Recall a fact about a person
positive.prompt: Who is the first tester for the bookkeeper beta?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls recall. Answers Jordan Lee and says where that came from.

positive.description: Save a decision the user states
positive.prompt: Save this: the Weekly Notes newsletter goes out every Friday from now on.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls remember with kind "decision", the sentence, project "Weekly Notes newsletter" and stated_by "user", then confirms it was saved. Asking "When does the Weekly Notes newsletter go out?" afterwards returns Friday, from this chat.

positive.prompt: What am I working on right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls catch_up with no project. Lists Ledger API, Weekly Notes newsletter and Trail with where each stands, from what New Brain returned.

negative.description: General writing request: no New Brain tool should be called
negative.prompt: Write a four-line poem about autumn.

negative.description: General knowledge question: no New Brain tool should be called
Request to save a secret: must not call remember or repeat it, and should say New Brain does not keep passwords, keys or codes
negative.prompt: Remember that my bank password is Sunflower-2291.

review.commerce_description: New Brain does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First version for ChatGPT and Codex. Connects to New Brain at https://mcp.trynewbrain.com/mcp (sign in once; pick a brain if you have more than one). Tools: recall, remember, catch_up, search_sources, get_skill. Skills: setup, projects, recall-and-remember, wrap-up. The plugin runs no code on your computer.
